text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After this day's mini-live, Silence Suzuka 
spoke with fans to learn how the concert 
performances affected her running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A fan shared how happy it makes them to 
shout together and feel connected at 
concerts. They also said it's a place 
where they can say, "Welcome back"—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The racegoers just want the racers to 
return safe and sound. That's why everyone 
wants to shout, "Welcome back!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hearing that, Silence Suzuka decided that 
during her next live performance, she 
would make a conscious effort to listen to 
the voices of those cheering for her.
